verdict.rationale: Temporal documents configuring retention per Namespace, and Archival moves closed Workflow Histories and Visibility records to blob storage for longer retention. Both are first-party retention controls, but neither is described in any depth. missing for 10: explicit documentation of data deletion (purging workflow histories or deleting namespaces/data), detail on retention period settings and their effects, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Namespaces: Create and manage Namespace isolation, retention, and related configuration.
Archival: Move closed Workflow Histories and Visibility records to blob storage for longer retention.
